title: suffixes 与 validate：把「静默错误」变成「显式失败」
expected_output:
两表都有同名列 name 和 v（非键）

=== 默认后缀 _x / _y：可读性最差的来源 ===
  列名: ['id', 'name_x', 'v_x', 'name_y', 'v_y']
 id name_x  v_x name_y  v_y
  1      甲   10      A  100
  2      乙   20      B  200

=== 显式 suffixes：进报表前必须做的一步 ===
  列名: ['id', 'name_左', 'v_左', 'name_右', 'v_右']
 id name_左  v_左 name_右  v_右
  1      甲   10      A  100
  2      乙   20      B  200

=== validate：声明基数关系，越界立刻失败 ===
  validate=one_to_one   左2r 右2r -> 通过，2 行
  validate=one_to_many  左2r 右2r -> 通过，2 行
  validate=one_to_one   左2r 右2r -> MergeError
      -> Merge keys are not unique in right dataset; not a one-to-one merge Duplicates in right:   id   1 ...

=== merge 的键 dtype 不一致：Pandas 会主动拦截 ===
  左 id dtype = int64  右 id dtype = str
  直接 merge -> ValueError
      You are trying to merge on int64 and str columns for key 'id'. If you wish to proceed you should use
  【这是一件好事】：主动失败 > 静默返回空结果

  统一 dtype 之后：
     结果 2 行，id = [1, 2]
  教训：合并前先断言 assert left[k].dtype == right[k].dtype
code:
import pandas as pd

left = pd.DataFrame({"id": [1, 2], "name": ["甲", "乙"], "v": [10, 20]})
right = pd.DataFrame({"id": [1, 2], "name": ["A", "B"], "v": [100, 200]})
print("两表都有同名列 name 和 v（非键）")

print()
print("=== 默认后缀 _x / _y：可读性最差的来源 ===")
d = pd.merge(left, right, on="id")
print("  列名:", list(d.columns))
print(d.to_string(index=False))

print()
print("=== 显式 suffixes：进报表前必须做的一步 ===")
c = pd.merge(left, right, on="id", suffixes=("_左", "_右"))
print("  列名:", list(c.columns))
print(c.to_string(index=False))

print()
print("=== validate：声明基数关系，越界立刻失败 ===")
cases = [
    ("one_to_one",   left, right),
    ("one_to_many",  left, right),
    ("one_to_one",   left, pd.DataFrame({"id": [1, 1], "w": [7, 8]})),
]
for v, L, R in cases:
    try:
        out = pd.merge(L, R, on="id", validate=v)
        print("  validate=%-12s 左%dr 右%dr -> 通过，%d 行" % (v, len(L), len(R), len(out)))
    except Exception as e:
        print("  validate=%-12s 左%dr 右%dr -> %s" % (v, len(L), len(R), type(e).__name__))
        print("      ->", str(e).replace(chr(10), " ")[:110])

print()
print("=== merge 的键 dtype 不一致：Pandas 会主动拦截 ===")
a = pd.DataFrame({"id": [1, 2], "x": [1, 2]})
b = pd.DataFrame({"id": ["1", "2"], "y": [10, 20]})
print("  左 id dtype =", a["id"].dtype, " 右 id dtype =", b["id"].dtype)
try:
    m = pd.merge(a, b, on="id", how="inner")
    print("  直接 merge -> %d 行" % len(m))
except Exception as e:
    print("  直接 merge -> %s" % type(e).__name__)
    print("      " + str(e).replace(chr(10), " ")[:100])
    print("  【这是一件好事】：主动失败 > 静默返回空结果")

print()
print("  统一 dtype 之后：")
m2 = pd.merge(a, b.assign(id=b["id"].astype(int)), on="id", how="inner")
print("     结果 %d 行，id = %s" % (len(m2), m2["id"].tolist()))
print("  教训：合并前先断言 assert left[k].dtype == right[k].dtype")
